properties.notes: The site comprises two parts separated by a brick wall – the western section is a commercial yard containing a number of buildings/workshops and an area of hardstanding, and the eastern section consists of the gardens belonging to properties along Swanley Village Road. The site is surrounded by residential development and a pub.
